sourceText:
Oatmeal Squares
By: Anonymous
Published: Tuesday, December 1, 2009 - 12:25am

Ingredients




1/2 cup Granulated sugar
1/4 cup Margarine or butter
1/4 cup Shortening
1/2 teaspoon Ground cinnamon
1/4 teaspoon Baking powder
1 1/2 cups Quick-cooking oats
1 cup Raisins or chopped nuts
if using self rising flour
Baking soda
Salt.
1/2 cup Packed brown sugar softened`
1/2 teaspoon Baking soda
1/2 teaspoon Vanilla
1 Egg
1 cup All-purpose flour*
If desired omit
and

Preparation

1 Heat oven to 375 degrees. Mix all ingredients except oats, flour and raisins. Stir in oats, flour and raisins. Press dough in ungreased square pan, 8 X 8 X 2 inches. Bake about 25 minutes or until light brown. Cut into about 2-inch squares while warm. 16 SQUARES; 165 CALORIES PER SQUARE.
